Learn more about the lawsuits shaping voting rights, redistricting and elections by exploring Democracy Docket’s comprehensive database of cases. Click on any case to find a brief summary of the lawsuit and all relevant filings in the “case documents” section.

United States of America v. Matthews

An anti-voting lawsuit seeking to compel Illinois to provide the DOJ with access to its complete statewide voter registration database.

Filed: 
							
								
									December 18, 2025

Decided: 
							
								
									July 31, 2026

Kansas Appleseed Center for Law and Justice v. Schwab

A pro-voting lawsuit challenging a state law that disqualifies mail ballots that arrive after election day.

Filed: 
							
								
									May 5, 2025

Decided: 
							
								
									July 30, 2026

LULAC v. Pate et al

An anti-voting lawsuit seeking to suppress absentee ballot access in Iowa.

Filed: 
							
								
									July 30, 2026

Democratic National Committee v. Boehm

Petition filed by the Democratic National Committee (DNC) and a voter against City of Walworth Clerk, Heather Boehm, seeking to extend the in-person voting hours at two polling locations from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.

Filed: 
							
								
									November 5, 2024

Decided: 
							
								
									July 29, 2026

United States of America v. Caldwell

An anti-voting lawsuit seeking to compel New Jersey to provide the DOJ with access to its statewide voter registration data.

Filed: 
							
								
									February 26, 2026

Decided: 
							
								
									July 29, 2026

Californians for Voter ID et al v. Weber et al

An anti-voting lawsuit challenging the attorney general’s wording of a Republican-led state voter ID ballot measure.

Filed: 
							
								
									July 28, 2026

Bins v. Wisconsin Elections Commission

A pro-voting lawsuit challenging Wisconsin guidance that blocks absentee voters from casting a replacement ballot before Election Day.

Filed: 
							
								
									July 23, 2026

State of Illinois et al v. Federal Emergency Management Agency et al

A pro-voting lawsuit challenging the Trump administration withholding FEMA funds from blue states as part of the president’s crusade to implement anti-voting measures before the midterms.

Filed: 
							
								
									July 23, 2026

United States of America v. Adams

An anti-voting lawsuit seeking to compel Kentucky to provide the DOJ with access to its complete statewide voter registration database.

Filed: 
							
								
									February 26, 2026

Decided: 
							
								
									July 23, 2026

League of Women Voters of Wisconsin et al v. Wisconsin Elections Commission et al

A pro-voting lawsuit seeking to allow Wisconsin voters to cast in-person provisional ballots on election day if their mail-in ballot is delayed or lost in the mail.

Filed: 
							
								
									July 23, 2026
